mapper.select: SELECT id, energy_type, factor_name, factor_value, unit, effective_date, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_emission_factor ORDER BY id
SELECT id, energy_type, factor_name, factor_value, unit, effective_date, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_emission_factor WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, energy_type, factor_name, factor_value, unit, effective_date, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_emission_factor WHERE id = #{id}
